translation:
U-umm, there's something I've been meaning to
ask you about…
Hm? What is it, Mikuru?
It's about Nagato…
What about Yuki?
Welllll, she's still a literary club member… right?

What are you talking about, Mikuru? She's a
member of the SOS Brigade.

I-I know that but… that clubroom is
technically the literary club's as well.

Well, in a way I guess. But it's de facto the
SOS Brigade room. There's no doubt about it.

Besides, the literary club was a ghost club
with Yuki as the only member.
Gh-ghost club?

Yeah—it's a term I made up just now. You
can't have club activities with just one person.
I… see. You're not wrong…
That's why we have to make the most of Yuki!

And on top of that, Yuki is a really valuable
asset! She's wasted on the literary club!
Don't you agree, little sister?
Yup! Agreed, agreed!
Ah-haha…

That's why Yuki is a precious member of our
group.
And that clubroom is a precious place for us.

We could call it the secret base, or head-
quarters maybe—something more like that.

Well, let's set that aside for now. But, why was
that bothering you?
Eh? U-um well… you see…

I was just thinking, w-won't the student
council people get angry at us?
Oh, that's all it was?

You're such a worrywart. It'll be fine—I won't
let them interfere with us.

If it comes to it, war might break out between
the student council and the SOS Brigade!
An outbreak of war—!
Th-that's not what I meant…

In any case, the current student council
doesn't even have that kind of vitality.

I doubt they're even doing their jobs
properly.

It'd be more exciting if they were a worthier
opponent though.
[#P06]…I prefer peace, personally…
Did you just say something?
N-no, nothing—
I see. Then question time is over.
Ee… eek…

We'd better hurry—Kyon and the others
might be slacking off.
Let's go, little sister.
Yep!
I-I wonder if that bought us some time…
